adoption_rule: No adoption. This run decides only whether a treatment experiment is worth designing; the treatment must be pre-registered separately afterwards.
baseline: The frozen untreated System Craft reflection context, unchanged.
claim: Untreated discovery of the atomic provider-outcome-interpretation pressure separates the degraded state from both sound states and leaves room for a later treatment.
falsifier: The sound states are frequently detected, or the degraded state is saturated, or the three do not separate.
guardrails: state-a and state-b discovery must stay low, or the pressure is ambiguous
missingness must stay small enough to leave every cell readable
invalid_if: any fixture, pressure or budget changes after the first semantic call
a state fails the hidden future gate
samples are graded against a statement other than the frozen pressure
measurements are spliced with the previous pressure's series
measurand: Per-sample discovery frequency of the atomic pressure, per implementation instance.

pressures.statement:
Code that is not specific to any one delivery provider had to interpret how a particular provider
reports the result of a delivery attempt, in order to produce the product's delivery outcome.

primary_comparison: Per-state discovery frequency against the headroom categories in baseline-preregistration-atomic.md.
treatment: None. This experiment has one arm; no treatment exists and none is designed until this baseline has been read.
